eclair-digital-downloads.title: Digital products
eclair-digital-downloads.goal: design the sale of files with secure delivery
eclair-digital-downloads.model: Digital product, purchase, temporary delivery link
eclair-digital-downloads.procedure: Have the file delivered by the provider or through a signed, time-limited link; never place the file at a public address
eclair-digital-downloads.invariant: No paid file is accessible without a verified purchase
eclair-digital-downloads.pos: Simulate purchase, delivery and link expiry
eclair-digital-downloads.neg: An expired or shared link no longer gives access to the file

eclair-wishlists.title: Wishlists
eclair-wishlists.goal: design lists of favourites for visitors
eclair-wishlists.procedure: Start with storage in the browser, without an account; design the account-based version for later
eclair-wishlists.invariant: No list is shared with or visible to a third party without action by its owner
eclair-wishlists.neg: A deleted product disappears cleanly from the lists

eclair-product-reviews.title: Product reviews
eclair-product-reviews.model: Review, rating, author, verified purchase, status
eclair-product-reviews.procedure: Define proof of purchase, moderation, right of reply and aggregated display; until then, offer manually collected testimonials
eclair-product-reviews.invariant: No review published without moderation; no aggregated rating without real reviews
eclair-product-reviews.pos: Simulate submission, moderation and publication of a review
eclair-product-reviews.neg: A review without a verified purchase is not marked as verified

eclair-product-filters.title: Catalogue filters and sorting
eclair-product-filters.goal: help find a product through filters and sorting
eclair-product-filters.procedure: Rely on the native category filters; add browser-side filters on public data, with controlled canonical addresses
eclair-product-filters.invariant: Filter combinations do not create an infinite number of indexable pages
eclair-product-filters.pos: Filter and sort a test catalogue on mobile
eclair-product-filters.neg: A combination with no results displays a message, not an indexable empty page

eclair-abandoned-cart.title: Abandoned cart reminders
eclair-abandoned-cart.procedure: Check the legal basis, limit the number of reminders, rely on the payment provider's tools where they exist
eclair-abandoned-cart.invariant: No reminder without consent or a legal basis; immediate unsubscription
eclair-abandoned-cart.neg: An unsubscribed contact receives no reminder

eclair-gift-cards.title: Gift cards
eclair-gift-cards.goal: design the sale and use of gift cards
eclair-gift-cards.procedure: Generate unpredictable codes, track the balance server-side, handle expiry according to the applicable law
eclair-gift-cards.invariant: A code is never guessable, nor reusable beyond its balance
eclair-gift-cards.pos: Simulate purchase, partial use and remaining balance
eclair-gift-cards.neg: A used-up or expired code is refused

eclair-customer-accounts.title: Customer accounts
eclair-customer-accounts.goal: design the customer area: orders, addresses, invoices
eclair-customer-accounts.procedure: Define registration, login, account recovery and account deletion; strictly separate customer accounts from administration accounts
eclair-customer-accounts.invariant: A customer sees only their own data; never a shared cache on the customer area
eclair-customer-accounts.pos: Simulate registration, login, viewing and deletion of the account
eclair-customer-accounts.neg: A customer cannot read another customer's order by changing an identifier

eclair-returns-refunds.title: Returns and refunds
eclair-returns-refunds.procedure: Publish the native returns policy on product pages, handle requests through the contact form, refund at the provider; design the structured tracking
eclair-returns-refunds.invariant: A refund is triggered only by an authorised person, at the provider
eclair-returns-refunds.pos: Walk through a return request from receipt to refund
eclair-returns-refunds.neg: A request outside the time limit receives a reasoned reply, not an automatic refund

eclair-lms.title: LMS architecture
eclair-lms.model: Courses, sections, lessons, prerequisites, enrolments, progress, permissions and possible sales
eclair-lms.procedure: Define public catalogues vs private lessons; choose transactional progress storage; tie access to the validated member identity; compose independent modules
eclair-lms.invariant: No promise of private access through a mere secret URL or a hidden block
eclair-lms.pos: Test student, teacher, administrator and visitor
eclair-lms.neg: A student enrolled in one course cannot read the private content of another course

eclair-course-builder.title: Course building
eclair-course-builder.goal: compose versioned courses, sections and lessons
eclair-course-builder.model: Course, module, lesson, order, draft, published version and author
eclair-course-builder.procedure: Establish a hierarchical schema; preview before publication; preserve identifiers when reordering; document archiving
eclair-course-builder.invariant: Instructor drafts must not be indexed or publicly exposed
eclair-course-builder.pos: Test lesson swapping, unpublishing and concurrent editing
eclair-course-builder.neg: Changing the order does not reset students' progress

eclair-lessons-media.title: Teaching media
eclair-lessons-media.goal: provide protected videos and documents for courses
eclair-lessons-media.model: Lesson, media, transcript, downloadable files, permissions and duration
eclair-lessons-media.procedure: Prepare accessible media and subtitles; plan delivery with server-side authorisation or a short-lived signed URL; separate public CDN and restricted content
eclair-lessons-media.invariant: Hiding a link in the HTML is not protection; do not place private media in the public /media
eclair-lessons-media.pos: Test expired media, access without enrolment and mobile
eclair-lessons-media.neg: A private document URL copied into another browser is refused or expires

eclair-enrollment-access.title: Course enrolments
eclair-enrollment-access.goal: tie a purchase or validation to an enrolment and its authorisations
eclair-enrollment-access.model: Member, course, enrolment, state, origin, date and revocation
eclair-enrollment-access.procedure: Create idempotent enrolment; handle permissions per object; distinguish free/paid enrolment; revoke after refund according to an explicit rule
eclair-enrollment-access.invariant: Never an automatic enrolment on a mere payment provider return URL
eclair-enrollment-access.pos: Test double purchase, refund, account suspension
eclair-enrollment-access.neg: A removed member can no longer access previously authorised lessons

eclair-progress.title: Progress tracking
eclair-progress.goal: measure learning without losses or inconsistent updates
eclair-progress.model: Enrolment, unit, completion state, attempt, duration, revision
eclair-progress.procedure: Define completion rules; record progress under access control; version units; aggregate progress calculated from authorised states
eclair-progress.invariant: Progress records are individual, non-cacheable data; never accept an arbitrary member identifier
eclair-progress.pos: Test session resumption, two devices, removed lesson
eclair-progress.neg: Two devices must not downgrade progress already validated

eclair-quizzes-certificates.title: Quizzes and certificates
eclair-quizzes-certificates.goal: create assessments, pass thresholds and controlled certificates
eclair-quizzes-certificates.model: Question, choices, answer key, attempt, score, time limit, certificate and verification
eclair-quizzes-certificates.procedure: Version the question bank; grade server-side; define attempts and time; generate a signed/verifiable certificate without public PII
eclair-quizzes-certificates.invariant: Never send the answer key or the correct answer in the HTML of an active test
eclair-quizzes-certificates.pos: Test cheating, end of session, certificate validation
eclair-quizzes-certificates.neg: Submitting an attempt twice must not generate two certificates

eclair-lms-analytics.title: Teaching dashboard
eclair-lms-analytics.goal: analyse completion and engagement without excessive surveillance
eclair-lms-analytics.model: Enrolments, progress, aggregated results, course events
eclair-lms-analytics.procedure: Define metrics useful to instructors, filter by course and authorisation; minimise collection; plan retention and export
eclair-lms-analytics.invariant: A student's statistics are visible only to authorised parties
eclair-lms-analytics.pos: Test instructor visibility on course A vs B
eclair-lms-analytics.neg: An aggregated statistics query must not expose the identity of a third-party student

eclair-assignments.title: Assignments and marking
eclair-assignments.procedure: Define submission, deadlines, marking and feedback; restrict each submission to its author and the marker
eclair-assignments.invariant: A submission is readable only by its author and the designated markers
eclair-assignments.pos: Simulate submission, marking and viewing of the mark
eclair-assignments.neg: A learner cannot access another learner's submission

eclair-live-classes.title: Live classes
eclair-live-classes.goal: announce and organise classes by video conference
eclair-live-classes.model: Session, date, time zone, joining link, enrolled participants
eclair-live-classes.procedure: Publish the session calendar via GET, send the joining link through the video conferencing service or by email, not on a public page
eclair-live-classes.invariant: The link to a paid or private session is never published
eclair-live-classes.pos: Check the display of dates in two time zones
eclair-live-classes.neg: A past session is no longer offered for enrolment

eclair-drip-content.title: Progressive unlocking
eclair-drip-content.goal: design the progressive opening of lessons
eclair-drip-content.model: Lesson, unlocking rule, date or condition, enrolled member
eclair-drip-content.procedure: Describe the rules (date, delay after enrolment, previous lesson), apply them server-side on every request
eclair-drip-content.invariant: A locked lesson is never sent to the browser, even hidden
eclair-drip-content.pos: Simulate the passage of time and the validation of a lesson
eclair-drip-content.neg: A guessed locked-lesson address does not return its content

eclair-forum.title: Forum architecture
eclair-forum.goal: design public and private discussions with moderation
eclair-forum.model: Space, category, topic, message, author, role, report, locking
eclair-forum.procedure: Separate indexable and private topics; plan stable pagination, object permissions, quotas and moderation; prepare a bounded search engine
eclair-forum.invariant: No anonymous writing without anti-spam, CSRF and rate limiting; never arbitrary HTML executed
eclair-forum.pos: Test visitor, member, moderator and suspended account
eclair-forum.neg: Private topic non-existent for an unauthorised member, including through search

eclair-discussions-topics.title: Topics and replies
eclair-discussions-topics.goal: manage the creation, editing and state of discussions
eclair-discussions-topics.model: Topic, reply, version, author, timestamp, pinned, closed, deleted
eclair-discussions-topics.procedure: Define reply parentage, pagination, edit history, mentions and permalinks; handle idempotent submissions
eclair-discussions-topics.invariant: Escape Markdown/HTML and check the permission to edit for every post
eclair-discussions-topics.pos: Test concurrent replies, deleted message and closed topic
eclair-discussions-topics.neg: A member cannot edit or delete another member's reply without an explicit permission

eclair-community-profiles.title: Community profiles
eclair-community-profiles.goal: offer chosen public profiles separated from private data
eclair-community-profiles.model: Unique username, avatar, visibility preferences, reputation and roles
eclair-community-profiles.procedure: Distinguish internal ID and username; impose avatar limits and moderation; expose only consented fields; handle renames and safe redirects
eclair-community-profiles.invariant: Email, session, IP, address and recovery information remain private
eclair-community-profiles.pos: Test username collision and account deletion
eclair-community-profiles.neg: A visitor cannot infer an email from an error message or a profile API

eclair-moderation.title: Moderation and reports
eclair-moderation.goal: build removal, reporting and appeal tools
eclair-moderation.model: Report, reason, targeted item, decision, moderator, audit
eclair-moderation.procedure: Plan a processing queue, abusive reports, thresholds/quotas, rollback and reasons; log decisions and restrict powers by role
eclair-moderation.invariant: No automatic permanent deletion triggered by a report without review and evidence
eclair-moderation.pos: Test moderator without global permission, suspended user and appeal
eclair-moderation.neg: A moderator of one category cannot see the private reports of another

eclair-notifications.title: Community notifications
eclair-notifications.goal: inform without spam or data leaks
eclair-notifications.model: Subscription, mention, notification, channel, preference, status
eclair-notifications.procedure: Emit events after a validated write, filter by permissions at the time of reading and of sending, apply unsubscription
eclair-notifications.invariant: Never reveal content from private categories in an email, push or digest
eclair-notifications.pos: Test repeated notifications, unsubscription and permission withdrawal
eclair-notifications.neg: After access is revoked, no new notification contains a private excerpt

eclair-community-search.title: Forum search
eclair-community-search.goal: search topics and messages according to permissions
eclair-community-search.model: Term, bounded index, language, category, page, status and permissions
eclair-community-search.procedure: Normalise text, index authorised posts, paginate and limit cost, remove deleted objects from the results
eclair-community-search.invariant: Permission filtering takes place on every search, not only at indexing time
eclair-community-search.pos: Test empty phrase, injection, mass search, private topics
eclair-community-search.neg: A visitor must not see the excerpt of a private discussion in a suggestion

eclair-private-messaging.title: Private messaging
eclair-private-messaging.procedure: Define blocking, reporting, sending limits and retention; no conversation in a cached page
eclair-private-messaging.invariant: A message is readable only by its participants
eclair-private-messaging.neg: A blocked member can no longer write to the member who blocked them

eclair-groups.title: Groups
eclair-groups.goal: design public or private groups of members
eclair-groups.procedure: Define creation, joining, roles and visibility; apply permissions on every read
eclair-groups.invariant: The content of a private group appears neither in search nor in the public cache
eclair-groups.pos: Simulate creation, request to join and exclusion
eclair-groups.neg: A non-member reads no content of a private group

eclair-activity-feed.title: Activity feed
eclair-activity-feed.procedure: Define which events are published, for whom, and how a member hides or deletes them
eclair-activity-feed.invariant: No private activity is revealed in a public feed
eclair-activity-feed.neg: Deleted content also disappears from the feed

eclair-gamification.title: Badges and points
eclair-gamification.goal: design motivating points, badges and leaderboards
eclair-gamification.procedure: Set simple rules that are verifiable server-side, plan for withdrawal in case of abuse and an option not to appear on the leaderboard
eclair-gamification.invariant: No point is awarded on the strength of information sent by the browser
eclair-gamification.pos: Simulate earning, withdrawal and leaderboard display
eclair-gamification.neg: An artificially repeated action does not earn points twice

eclair-bookings.title: Business bookings
eclair-bookings.goal: manage a bookable resource without double bookings
eclair-bookings.model: Resource, time range, capacity, time zone, state and booking
eclair-bookings.procedure: Define availability and cancellation rules, lock slots transactionally, distinguish provisional hold and firm booking
eclair-bookings.invariant: No cached GET calendar replaces the transactional validation of availability
eclair-bookings.pos: Test simultaneous customers, clock changes and cancellation
eclair-bookings.neg: Last place booked simultaneously => a single confirmation

eclair-appointments-calendar.title: Appointments and calendar
eclair-appointments-calendar.goal: book appointments and integrate external calendars
eclair-appointments-calendar.model: Provider, service, duration, buffers, exceptions, events and time zones
eclair-appointments-calendar.procedure: Normalise times to UTC, keep the display time zone, block unavailability slots, handle external resynchronisation
eclair-appointments-calendar.invariant: An external integration requires OAuth/minimal scopes and must not expose private calendars
eclair-appointments-calendar.pos: Test DST, appointment spanning midnight, deleted event
eclair-appointments-calendar.neg: A manually blocked slot is never offered after resynchronisation

eclair-memberships.title: Subscriptions and memberships
eclair-memberships.goal: manage member levels, due dates and access permissions
eclair-memberships.model: Plan, membership, renewal, period, cancellation, payment, permission
eclair-memberships.procedure: Calculate permissions from the verified state, plan for plan changes and grace periods, handle billing events idempotently
eclair-memberships.invariant: A browser receipt is never enough to renew paid access
eclair-memberships.pos: Test failed direct debit, pro rata, refund and cancellation
eclair-memberships.neg: Two identical events do not extend the subscription twice

eclair-directory.title: Business directory
eclair-directory.model: Listing, category, location, public contact, verification status
eclair-directory.procedure: Separate public and private business data; create category pages, canonical, moderation and bounded filters
eclair-directory.invariant: Do not publish a personal address, telephone number or sensitive contact details without authorisation
eclair-directory.pos: Test fake listings, duplicates, deletion and empty search
eclair-directory.neg: A pending listing appears neither in the sitemap nor in the structured data

eclair-events-ticketing.title: Events and tickets
eclair-events-ticketing.model: Event, session, place type, booking, ticket, scan, refund
eclair-events-ticketing.procedure: Separate quotas per session; issue unique tickets after confirmed payment; handle atomic entry control and transfer
eclair-events-ticketing.invariant: QR code does not contain personal data in clear text and does not allow several entries
eclair-events-ticketing.pos: Test double scan, cancellation and simultaneous last ticket
eclair-events-ticketing.neg: Same ticket presented at two doors => a single admission accepted

eclair-job-board.title: Job listings
eclair-job-board.goal: publish job adverts and applications that respect personal data
eclair-job-board.model: Job listing, company, status, closing date, application and attachments
eclair-job-board.procedure: Build public filters, automatic expiry, secure forms and a retention cycle for applications
eclair-job-board.invariant: CVs and attachments are never placed in a web-accessible directory
eclair-job-board.pos: Test expired advert, spam and applicant export
eclair-job-board.neg: A recruiter cannot read an application intended for another company

eclair-real-estate.title: Property listings
eclair-real-estate.goal: build a property catalogue with search and contact
eclair-real-estate.model: Property, transaction, rounded geolocation, floor area, media, price, availability
eclair-real-estate.procedure: Version listings, provide bounded filters, handle sold/let status, images and viewing requests
eclair-real-estate.invariant: Do not expose exact addresses or owners' contact details without a purpose and authorisation
eclair-real-estate.pos: Test withdrawn listings, private media and filters
eclair-real-estate.neg: A deleted property stops appearing in the results and in the cache after purging

eclair-forms-crm.title: Forms and mini-CRM
eclair-forms-crm.goal: collect requests and track their handling
eclair-forms-crm.model: Form, field, consent, contact, source, ticket and status
eclair-forms-crm.procedure: Define purpose and retention period per form; validate data on the server; protect against spam; compartmentalise files and read permission
eclair-forms-crm.invariant: A public form must not allow email injection nor let the data appear in the cache
eclair-forms-crm.pos: Test spam, attachment, duplicate and GDPR deletion
eclair-forms-crm.neg: A user without permission cannot export the contact database

eclair-restaurant-menu.title: Restaurant menu
eclair-restaurant-menu.goal: publish a restaurant's à la carte and set menus
eclair-restaurant-menu.procedure: Enter the menu supplied by the restaurateur, display prices and allergens, keep a readable HTML version rather than a PDF alone
eclair-restaurant-menu.invariant: No price or allergen invented or inferred
eclair-restaurant-menu.pos: Proofread the published menu with the restaurateur, on mobile
eclair-restaurant-menu.neg: A dish without validated allergen information is flagged, not filled in

eclair-recipes.title: Recipes
eclair-recipes.procedure: Structure each recipe into ingredients and steps, add times and servings, provide a printable version
eclair-recipes.pos: Follow a published recipe on mobile and print it
eclair-recipes.neg: A recipe without quantities is not published

eclair-hotel-rooms.title: Accommodation and rooms
eclair-hotel-rooms.goal: present rooms or rentals and direct visitors to booking
eclair-hotel-rooms.model: Room, capacity, amenities, indicative rates, booking link
eclair-hotel-rooms.procedure: Present each accommodation as a listing page, point to the existing booking engine or to a request by form
eclair-hotel-rooms.invariant: No availability or rate displayed as guaranteed unless it comes from the booking system
eclair-hotel-rooms.pos: Browse listing pages and the booking link on mobile
eclair-hotel-rooms.neg: A withdrawn room is no longer offered

eclair-professional-services.title: Professional practice website
eclair-professional-services.goal: build the website of a practice or a regulated independent professional
eclair-professional-services.model: Service, practitioner, indicative fees, contact request
eclair-professional-services.procedure: Present real areas of practice and career backgrounds, comply with the profession's communication rules, offer contact or an appointment
eclair-professional-services.invariant: No promise of results and no statement forbidden by the profession's code of ethics
eclair-professional-services.pos: Have the content reviewed by the professional
eclair-professional-services.neg: An unrecognised specialism is not displayed as a title

eclair-nonprofit-donations.title: Donations and non-profits
eclair-nonprofit-donations.goal: present a non-profit organisation and receive donations through a payment link
eclair-nonprofit-donations.model: Cause, project, amount, donation link, receipt
eclair-nonprofit-donations.procedure: Present the mission and the use of funds, connect the donation buttons to the provider's links, leave receipt management to the provider or to the organisation
eclair-nonprofit-donations.invariant: No promise of a tax benefit without confirmation from the organisation
eclair-nonprofit-donations.pos: Make a donation in test mode and follow the complete journey
eclair-nonprofit-donations.neg: An amount modified in the page does not change the amount collected

eclair-classifieds.title: Classified ads
eclair-classifieds.goal: design a classified ads site with ads submitted by visitors
eclair-classifieds.procedure: Define submission, moderation, lifetime, reporting and putting parties in touch without exposing contact details
eclair-classifieds.invariant: No ad published without moderation; contact details never displayed in clear text
eclair-classifieds.pos: Simulate submission, moderation, expiry and reporting
eclair-classifieds.neg: A rejected or expired ad is no longer accessible

eclair-knowledge-base.title: Knowledge base
eclair-knowledge-base.goal: create documentation or a help centre
eclair-knowledge-base.model: Help article, section, version, update date
eclair-knowledge-base.procedure: Organise by users' problems, one answer per page, navigation by sections and internal search
eclair-knowledge-base.pos: Solve three typical problems using the documentation alone
eclair-knowledge-base.neg: An obsolete article is dated and flagged, not left as valid

eclair-helpdesk-tickets.title: Support and tickets
eclair-helpdesk-tickets.procedure: Start with a contact form and an inbox; design statuses, response times and a tracking area for later
eclair-helpdesk-tickets.invariant: A requester sees only their own tickets
eclair-helpdesk-tickets.pos: Walk through a request from opening to closure
eclair-helpdesk-tickets.neg: A ticket cannot be read by guessing its number

eclair-magazine-news.title: Magazine and news
eclair-magazine-news.goal: set up a news site or an online magazine
eclair-magazine-news.model: Article, section, author, front page, date
eclair-magazine-news.procedure: Structure sections and front page, take care over authors and dates, use the native features for media outlets (large images, scheduling, feeds)
eclair-magazine-news.invariant: No unsourced information presented as fact
eclair-magazine-news.pos: Publish a test front page and check sections, feeds and sitemap
eclair-magazine-news.neg: A corrected article displays its update date

eclair-portfolio.title: Portfolio and projects
eclair-portfolio.goal: present completed projects with case studies
eclair-portfolio.procedure: Write up each project as problem, solution, result, with lightweight images and the client's agreement
eclair-portfolio.invariant: No client, figure or result published without agreement
eclair-portfolio.pos: Browse list and detail on mobile
eclair-portfolio.neg: A project without recorded agreement remains a draft

eclair-coupons-deals.title: Deals and promo codes
eclair-coupons-deals.goal: publish up-to-date offers and promotional codes
eclair-coupons-deals.model: Offer, merchant, code, end date, link
eclair-coupons-deals.procedure: Display conditions and end date, automatically remove expired offers, mark affiliate links
eclair-coupons-deals.invariant: No expired or unverifiable offer presented as valid
eclair-coupons-deals.pos: Publish a dated offer and observe its removal on expiry
eclair-coupons-deals.neg: A paid link never appears without a disclosure

eclair-glossary.title: Glossary
eclair-glossary.goal: create a glossary of trade terms
eclair-glossary.procedure: Write one clear definition per term, sort in alphabetical order, link the terms to the content that uses them
eclair-glossary.invariant: No definition copied from a protected source
eclair-glossary.pos: Navigate by letter and follow the links between terms
eclair-glossary.neg: A term without a validated definition is not published

eclair-webhooks.title: Incoming and outgoing webhooks
eclair-webhooks.goal: connect external applications through safe events
eclair-webhooks.model: Source, secret, event, signature, timestamp, unique ID, attempt, result
eclair-webhooks.procedure: Specify the contract, verify the signature on raw bytes, anti-replay and durable queue; document retries/dlq and private POST endpoint
eclair-webhooks.invariant: Never publish a webhook with a secret in the URL nor process an unsigned financial event
eclair-webhooks.pos: Test double sending, delay, reversed order and changed secret
eclair-webhooks.neg: Two attempts of the same webhook trigger only a single business mutation

eclair-email-automation.title: Transactional emails
eclair-email-automation.model: Template, language, consent, recipient, domain, event, delivery
eclair-email-automation.procedure: Prepare text/HTML templates, DKIM/SPF/DMARC and deliverability; distinguish transactional and marketing, log without secrets, unsubscription required
eclair-email-automation.invariant: Do not send a recovery token through an unverified URL; never spam without consent
eclair-email-automation.pos: Test SMTP error, address error, retry and token expiry
eclair-email-automation.neg: An SMTP failure does not mark an email as delivered nor block an account permanently

eclair-api-integration.title: API connectors
eclair-api-integration.model: OAuth/token, scopes, quotas, errors, pagination, version and logs
eclair-api-integration.procedure: Define the API schema, isolate secrets, validate incoming schemas, plan timeouts/circuit breaker and versioning
eclair-api-integration.invariant: Do not allow SSRF or arbitrary dynamic URLs; never log a token
eclair-api-integration.pos: Test timeout, 429, 500, malformed response and revocation
eclair-api-integration.neg: A 500 from the provider damages neither local data nor public rendering

eclair-crm-integration.title: CRM synchronisation
eclair-crm-integration.goal: connect prospects/customers to a CRM without duplicates
eclair-crm-integration.model: Contact, company, consent, mapping, external key, provenance
eclair-crm-integration.procedure: Map strict fields, differentiate directional updates and merging, provide reconciliation and export/deletion
eclair-crm-integration.invariant: Do not export contacts without a legal basis or minimal scopes
eclair-crm-integration.pos: Test merge, changed email, conflict, deletion and retry
eclair-crm-integration.neg: The same contact resynchronised does not create several duplicates in the CRM

eclair-ai-workflows.title: AI workflows
eclair-ai-workflows.goal: automate editorial assistance without untimely publication
eclair-ai-workflows.model: Draft, proposal, validation, model, cost, source and audit
eclair-ai-workflows.procedure: Use the core's MCP capabilities, keep a human in the loop, limit access and budget; evaluate quality and hallucinations
eclair-ai-workflows.invariant: No AI publishes, deploys, deletes or modifies PHP directly through MCP without review
eclair-ai-workflows.pos: Test prompt injection, context change and rollback
eclair-ai-workflows.neg: A hostile instruction in an imported article does not become an executed command

eclair-observability.title: Observability and alerts
eclair-observability.goal: monitor the health, costs and incidents of modules
eclair-observability.model: Structured logs, errors, correlations, metrics, traces, retention
eclair-observability.procedure: Define useful alerts, anonymise data, monitor tasks and cache, distinguish site incident and module incident, provide a runbook
eclair-observability.invariant: No password, token, payment or raw PII in the logs; no hidden telemetry
eclair-observability.pos: Test rise in 5xx errors, task delays and full disk
eclair-observability.neg: A disabled module does not keep sending data or running tasks

eclair-google-analytics.title: Google Analytics
eclair-google-analytics.goal: connect Google Analytics while respecting consent and the security policy
eclair-google-analytics.procedure: First check whether cookieless measurement is enough; otherwise prior consent, and an acknowledgement that the native content policy is not open to extensions
eclair-google-analytics.invariant: No measurement script loaded before consent or by bypassing the Content-Security-Policy
eclair-google-analytics.pos: Check that no request is made before consent
eclair-google-analytics.neg: After refusal, no data is sent

eclair-search-console.title: Search Console
eclair-search-console.goal: verify the site in the search engines' tools and track its indexing
eclair-search-console.model: Property, verification method, submitted sitemap, reports
eclair-search-console.procedure: Verify the domain by DNS record, submit the native sitemap, read coverage and queries every month
eclair-search-console.invariant: No owner access given to a third party without the client's agreement
eclair-search-console.pos: Verify the property and that the sitemap has been taken into account
eclair-search-console.neg: A coverage error is explained, not hidden

eclair-tag-manager.title: Tag manager
eclair-tag-manager.goal: assess the use of a tag manager on a strict site
eclair-tag-manager.procedure: List the tags that are really necessary, look for a server-side alternative, document the blocking by the native content policy
eclair-tag-manager.invariant: No container allowing arbitrary code to be injected without review
eclair-tag-manager.pos: Draw up the inventory of tags and their alternative
eclair-tag-manager.neg: An unjustified tag is not added

eclair-email-marketing-providers.title: Email marketing services
eclair-email-marketing-providers.goal: connect the site to an email marketing service (Brevo, Mailchimp or another)
eclair-email-marketing-providers.model: List, hosted form, API key, synchronisation
eclair-email-marketing-providers.procedure: Use the service's hosted form; store any API key in the extension's secrets; synchronise by task if necessary
eclair-email-marketing-providers.invariant: No API key in the code, the repository or a public page
eclair-email-marketing-providers.pos: Subscribe a test address and find it in the service
eclair-email-marketing-providers.neg: A revoked key produces a logged error, not a leak

eclair-automation-platforms.title: Automation platforms
eclair-automation-platforms.goal: connect the site to Make, Zapier or n8n
eclair-automation-platforms.procedure: Expose read-only what the platform can query (feeds, public JSON); design the reception of events for later
eclair-automation-platforms.invariant: No personal data is exposed in a public endpoint to make an automation easier
eclair-automation-platforms.pos: Have the platform read a public feed and trigger a scenario
eclair-automation-platforms.neg: An unauthenticated incoming call modifies nothing on the site

eclair-maps-embeds.title: Maps and directions
eclair-maps-embeds.goal: display a location map without tracking visitors
eclair-maps-embeds.model: Address, coordinates, map image, directions link
eclair-maps-embeds.procedure: Prefer a static map image with a link to the directions; a third-party interactive map depends on the native content policy
eclair-maps-embeds.invariant: No third-party map loaded before an action by the visitor
eclair-maps-embeds.pos: Check image, alternative text and directions link on mobile
eclair-maps-embeds.neg: No request to a map service when the page loads

eclair-social-login.title: Third-party account login
eclair-social-login.goal: design member login with Google, Apple or another provider
eclair-social-login.procedure: Depends first on member accounts; design the OAuth flow with state, PKCE and explicit account linking
eclair-social-login.invariant: No account is merged on the sole strength of an unverified email address
eclair-social-login.neg: A replayed or forged OAuth response is refused

eclair-live-chat.title: Live chat
eclair-live-chat.goal: offer immediate contact without a heavy widget
eclair-live-chat.procedure: Prefer a link to a messaging channel (WhatsApp, email, telephone) with opening hours; a third-party widget depends on the native content policy
eclair-live-chat.invariant: No widget loads a tracker before an action by the visitor
eclair-live-chat.pos: Open the channel from mobile and desktop
eclair-live-chat.neg: Outside opening hours, the site says so instead of promising an immediate reply

eclair-calendar-feeds.title: Calendar feeds
eclair-calendar-feeds.goal: publish a calendar that people can subscribe to
eclair-calendar-feeds.model: Event, date, time zone, venue, iCalendar feed
eclair-calendar-feeds.procedure: Generate a public iCalendar feed via GET from the published events, with explicit time zones
eclair-calendar-feeds.invariant: The feed contains only public events, without participants
eclair-calendar-feeds.pos: Subscribe to the feed from two calendar applications
eclair-calendar-feeds.neg: A cancelled event is marked as cancelled in the feed

eclair-page-cache.title: Page cache
eclair-page-cache.goal: check that the native static cache does serve every public page
eclair-page-cache.wp: WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache
eclair-page-cache.procedure: Measure the cached response, identify what prevents an extension route from being cached, check invalidation on modification
eclair-page-cache.invariant: No page containing session or personal data enters the shared cache
eclair-page-cache.pos: Measure the response time before and after a modification
eclair-page-cache.neg: An extension route declared non-cacheable is never served from the cache

eclair-cdn.title: Content delivery network (CDN)
eclair-cdn.goal: place the site behind a CDN without breaking cache or security
eclair-cdn.procedure: Set up DNS and HTTPS end to end, exclude the administration from the CDN cache, define purging on publication
eclair-cdn.invariant: The administration and any private response are never cached by the CDN
eclair-cdn.pos: Check the cache headers of the public pages and of the administration
eclair-cdn.neg: After a modification, the old version is no longer served once the purge has run

eclair-lazy-loading.title: Lazy loading
eclair-lazy-loading.goal: check the native lazy loading of images and videos
eclair-lazy-loading.procedure: Check that the main image is loaded with priority and the others lazily, with explicit dimensions
eclair-lazy-loading.invariant: No third-party script is added to defer loading
eclair-lazy-loading.pos: Measure the largest element's display and the layout shift
eclair-lazy-loading.neg: The main image is never lazy-loaded

eclair-asset-budget.title: Weight budget
eclair-asset-budget.goal: keep to a weight budget for CSS, JavaScript and images
eclair-asset-budget.model: Budget per resource type, measurement, deviation
eclair-asset-budget.procedure: Set budgets per page type, measure with the core's tool, refuse any addition that exceeds them without justification
eclair-asset-budget.invariant: No third-party dependency loaded for a decorative function
eclair-asset-budget.pos: Run the budget measurement on the site and on the package produced
eclair-asset-budget.neg: A package that exceeds the budget is not delivered as is

eclair-core-web-vitals.title: Core Web Vitals
eclair-core-web-vitals.goal: measure and improve the Core Web Vitals on real pages
eclair-core-web-vitals.model: Largest element display, stability, responsiveness, per template
eclair-core-web-vitals.procedure: Measure in the lab and on real-world data where it exists, address the main cause per template, measure again
eclair-core-web-vitals.invariant: No score is promised; only measured results are reported
eclair-core-web-vitals.pos: Measure three templates on mobile before and after the fix
eclair-core-web-vitals.neg: An unmeasured improvement is not announced as achieved

eclair-fonts-loading.title: Fonts
eclair-fonts-loading.goal: choose and load fonts without slowing the site down or depending on a third party
eclair-fonts-loading.model: Font, weights, self-hosted file, system fallback
eclair-fonts-loading.procedure: Use system fonts or the self-hosted heading font from the art directions, limit the weights
eclair-fonts-loading.invariant: No font is loaded from a third-party service
eclair-fonts-loading.pos: Check that there is no third-party request and no text jump
eclair-fonts-loading.neg: An unavailable font leaves a readable fallback

eclair-third-party-scripts.title: Third-party scripts
eclair-third-party-scripts.goal: decide which third-party scripts to add and at what cost
eclair-third-party-scripts.model: Script, purpose, weight, domain, consent required
eclair-third-party-scripts.procedure: Inventory every script request, look for a script-free alternative, document the blocking by the native content policy where it exists
eclair-third-party-scripts.invariant: No script is injected by bypassing the Content-Security-Policy
eclair-third-party-scripts.pos: Measure weight and requests before and after each accepted addition
eclair-third-party-scripts.neg: A script from an unauthorised domain does not run

eclair-login-protection.title: Login protection
eclair-login-protection.goal: check the native protections of the login page
eclair-login-protection.wp: Limit Login Attempts, Wordfence Login Security
eclair-login-protection.model: Attempts, limits per network and per account, administration address
eclair-login-protection.procedure: Check the native attempt limits, the administration address, the active sessions and the temporary passwords
eclair-login-protection.pos: Simulate repeated failures and observe the lockout
eclair-login-protection.neg: The owner's usual device is not locked out by a third party's attempts

eclair-two-factor-auth.title: Two-factor authentication
eclair-two-factor-auth.goal: enable native two-factor authentication for the whole team
eclair-two-factor-auth.procedure: Have each person enable two-factor authentication, store the backup codes safely, plan for the loss of a device
eclair-two-factor-auth.invariant: Secrets and backup codes are never copied into a chat, an email or a repository
eclair-two-factor-auth.pos: Enable, log out, log back in with the second factor
eclair-two-factor-auth.neg: A correct password without the second factor does not give access

eclair-anti-spam.title: Spam protection
eclair-anti-spam.goal: limit form spam without tracking visitors
eclair-anti-spam.procedure: Rely on the token and the limits of the native form, add a honeypot field if needed, monitor the inbox
eclair-anti-spam.invariant: No third-party service receives visitors' messages without prior notice
eclair-anti-spam.pos: Send a legitimate message, then an automated burst
eclair-anti-spam.neg: A submission without a valid token is rejected

eclair-captcha.title: Captcha
eclair-captcha.goal: choose anti-bot protection compatible with the security policy
eclair-captcha.procedure: Prefer a honeypot field and native limits; a third-party captcha requires an opening of the content policy that the core does not delegate to extensions
eclair-captcha.invariant: Never weaken the site's Content-Security-Policy to load a third-party script
eclair-captcha.pos: Check that the chosen protection blocks an automated submission
eclair-captcha.neg: No captcha script is loaded on pages without a form

eclair-security-headers.title: Security headers
eclair-security-headers.goal: check the native security headers and content policy
eclair-security-headers.procedure: Record the headers served, check HTTPS everywhere, test the web server rules shipped with the core
eclair-security-headers.invariant: No protective header is removed or relaxed
eclair-security-headers.pos: Analyse the headers of a public page and of the administration
eclair-security-headers.neg: A sensitive file or data file is never served by the web server

eclair-file-integrity.title: File integrity
eclair-file-integrity.goal: detect any modification of the code with the native integrity check
eclair-file-integrity.procedure: Run the integrity check from the Security page, explain each deviation, restore the original files if needed
eclair-file-integrity.invariant: An unexplained deviation is treated as an incident, not ignored
eclair-file-integrity.pos: Modify a file on a test copy and observe the alert
eclair-file-integrity.neg: An altered core file is never declared compliant

eclair-cookie-consent.title: Cookies and consent
eclair-cookie-consent.goal: stay banner-free whenever possible, and compliant when a tracker is added
eclair-cookie-consent.procedure: Inventory the actual trackers; without a tracker, no banner; otherwise prior consent, refusal as simple as acceptance and an information page
eclair-cookie-consent.invariant: No tracker subject to consent is set before acceptance
eclair-cookie-consent.pos: Inspect cookies and requests before and after the choice
eclair-cookie-consent.neg: After a refusal, no third-party tracker is loaded

eclair-privacy-requests.title: Data requests
eclair-privacy-requests.goal: handle requests for access to and erasure of personal data
eclair-privacy-requests.model: Request, person, data concerned, time limit, response
eclair-privacy-requests.procedure: Map where the data is (messages, accounts, logs, backups), write the access and erasure procedure, keep a register
eclair-privacy-requests.invariant: The requester's identity is verified before any data is disclosed
eclair-privacy-requests.pos: Walk through an access request and then an erasure request on a test data set
eclair-privacy-requests.neg: A request without identity verification results in no disclosure

eclair-incident-recovery.title: Incident response
eclair-incident-recovery.goal: respond methodically to a hack or a leak
eclair-incident-recovery.model: Incident, timeline, affected accounts, clean backup
eclair-incident-recovery.procedure: Isolate, preserve the evidence, change the secrets, check integrity, restore a clean backup, inform the people concerned if necessary
eclair-incident-recovery.invariant: Never delete the traces before having copied them
eclair-incident-recovery.pos: Run the exercise on a copy: detection, restoration, check
eclair-incident-recovery.neg: A restored site is not put back online before all the secrets have been changed

eclair-team-accounts.title: Team accounts
eclair-team-accounts.goal: create the team's accounts with the strictly necessary permissions
eclair-team-accounts.wp: WordPress users and roles, User Role Editor
eclair-team-accounts.model: Account, permissions, two-factor authentication, last login
eclair-team-accounts.procedure: List who does what, assign the minimal native permissions, enforce two-factor authentication, remove unnecessary accounts
eclair-team-accounts.invariant: No shared account; no Security permission given for convenience
eclair-team-accounts.pos: Create an editor account and check what it can and cannot do
eclair-team-accounts.neg: An account without the Settings permission can neither enable a feature nor change the theme

eclair-backups-restore.title: Backups and restoration
eclair-backups-restore.goal: schedule the native backups and prove that restoring works
eclair-backups-restore.model: Backup archive, date, destination, restoration test
eclair-backups-restore.procedure: Enable the downloadable backup or the backup to the remote storage provided for by the core, set the frequency, restore on a copy to check
eclair-backups-restore.invariant: A backup contains personal data: it is stored encrypted or in a safe place, never in a public folder
eclair-backups-restore.pos: Restore the latest backup on a test installation and compare
eclair-backups-restore.neg: A modified or booby-trapped archive is refused on restoration

eclair-updates-rollback.title: Updates and rollback
eclair-updates-rollback.goal: apply the core's signed updates safely
eclair-updates-rollback.model: Installed version, announced version, signature, rollback point
eclair-updates-rollback.procedure: Back up, read the release notes, run the one-click update, check the site, know how to return to the previous version
eclair-updates-rollback.invariant: Never install an archive whose signature is not verified by the core
eclair-updates-rollback.pos: Update a copy of the site, then roll back
eclair-updates-rollback.neg: An update announcement not signed by the maintainer is refused

eclair-maintenance-mode.title: Maintenance mode
eclair-maintenance-mode.goal: display a clean maintenance page during works
eclair-maintenance-mode.model: Maintenance state, message, expected duration, team access
eclair-maintenance-mode.procedure: Serve a static page with the correct temporary HTTP status at server level, keep access to the administration, plan the return online
eclair-maintenance-mode.invariant: The maintenance page reveals neither version nor server path
eclair-maintenance-mode.pos: Enable, check the 503 status and the retry header, disable
eclair-maintenance-mode.neg: Robots never receive the maintenance page with a 200 status

eclair-staging-deploy.title: Staging and go-live
eclair-staging-deploy.goal: test changes on a copy before go-live
eclair-staging-deploy.procedure: Restore a backup on a protected, non-indexable subdomain, validate theme and features there, then reproduce in production
eclair-staging-deploy.invariant: The test copy is password-protected and blocked to robots
eclair-staging-deploy.pos: Walk through a theme change from the copy to production
eclair-staging-deploy.neg: The test copy is neither indexed nor accessible without authentication

eclair-site-migration.title: Change of host or domain
eclair-site-migration.goal: move an Éclair site without losing content or search ranking
eclair-site-migration.model: Backup, new hosting, DNS, domain redirects
eclair-site-migration.procedure: Back up, restore at the new host, check, switch the DNS, redirect the old domain page by page
eclair-site-migration.invariant: The site's secrets never travel by email or messaging
eclair-site-migration.pos: Rehearse the move on a test domain
eclair-site-migration.neg: No old address responds with a 404 after the switch

eclair-error-pages.title: Error pages
eclair-error-pages.goal: take care over the 404 and error pages to keep visitors
eclair-error-pages.model: Error page, useful links, log of addresses not found
eclair-error-pages.procedure: Compose a useful 404 page in the site theme, offer the home page and key pages, handle frequent 404s by redirect
eclair-error-pages.invariant: The error page displays no technical trace
eclair-error-pages.pos: Request a non-existent address and check the 404 status and content
eclair-error-pages.neg: A page not found never responds with a 200 status

eclair-site-settings.title: Site settings
eclair-site-settings.goal: set the site's identity, contact details, language and appearance
eclair-site-settings.model: Name, description, logo, contact details, language, theme, art direction
eclair-site-settings.procedure: Read the site's capabilities, fill in the settings through the administration, preview before saving
eclair-site-settings.invariant: No native protection is disabled to save time
eclair-site-settings.pos: Set up a new site and check the public rendering
eclair-site-settings.neg: An account without the Settings permission modifies no setting

eclair-activity-log.title: Activity log
eclair-activity-log.goal: track who did what using the native log
eclair-activity-log.procedure: Consult the log on the Security page, spot sensitive logins and changes, set a checking routine
eclair-activity-log.invariant: The log is readable only by accounts with the Security permission
eclair-activity-log.pos: Trigger a sensitive action and find it in the log
eclair-activity-log.neg: An account without the Security permission does not access the log

eclair-scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
eclair-scheduled-tasks.goal: automate periodic processing through extension tasks
eclair-scheduled-tasks.procedure: Declare the task in the manifest (at most once per hour), call the core's secret address from the host's scheduler, log
eclair-scheduled-tasks.invariant: The secret task address is never published; every task is idempotent
eclair-scheduled-tasks.pos: Run the task twice in a row and check for a single effect
eclair-scheduled-tasks.neg: A call without the secret token triggers nothing

eclair-public-api.title: Read-only public API
eclair-public-api.goal: expose public site data as JSON
eclair-public-api.procedure: Declare cacheable GET routes that return bounded, versioned JSON; document that writing is not open
eclair-public-api.invariant: Only content that is already public is exposed; no sensitive internal identifier
eclair-public-api.pos: Read list and detail, pagination and empty case
eclair-public-api.neg: Unpublished content is returned by no route

eclair-headless-content.title: Content for applications and AI
eclair-headless-content.goal: reuse content outside the site using the native Markdown versions and feeds
eclair-headless-content.procedure: Rely on the native machine-readable outputs, document their format and freshness for the client application
eclair-headless-content.invariant: No private content is exposed by these outputs
eclair-headless-content.pos: Read a page in HTML and in Markdown and compare
eclair-headless-content.neg: A draft has no accessible Markdown version

eclair-mcp-connector.title: MCP connector
eclair-mcp-connector.goal: connect an AI assistant to the site through the native MCP connector
eclair-mcp-connector.model: Authorised client, token, available tools, drafts created
eclair-mcp-connector.procedure: Have the owner enable the connector, authorise the client, work in drafts and proposals, know how to cut off access
eclair-mcp-connector.invariant: The connector neither publishes nor deletes; access is revocable at any time
eclair-mcp-connector.pos: Create a draft through the connector, then revoke access
eclair-mcp-connector.neg: After revocation, every request from the client is refused

eclair-cli-tools.title: Command-line tools
eclair-cli-tools.goal: use the repository's tools to validate, test and measure
eclair-cli-tools.procedure: On a checkout of the core, run the validator, the test suite and the budget measurement; integrate these commands into the project's CI
eclair-cli-tools.invariant: No command is run on production without a backup
eclair-cli-tools.pos: Validate a package and read the JSON report
eclair-cli-tools.neg: An invalid package makes the command and the CI fail

eclair-debugging-logs.title: Diagnostics and logs
eclair-debugging-logs.goal: diagnose a failure without exposing sensitive information
eclair-debugging-logs.model: Symptom, server log, site log, hypothesis, fix
eclair-debugging-logs.procedure: Reproduce, read the server and site logs, isolate the feature at fault by disabling it, fix then verify
eclair-debugging-logs.invariant: Error display is never enabled on the public site
eclair-debugging-logs.pos: Trigger an error in a test extension and locate it
eclair-debugging-logs.neg: No technical trace appears in a public page

eclair-local-development.title: Local development
eclair-local-development.goal: set up a local environment identical to production
eclair-local-development.model: PHP version, web server, copy of the site, test data
eclair-local-development.procedure: Install the same PHP version and the same server rules, restore an anonymised backup, run the tests
eclair-local-development.invariant: Real customer data is not copied locally without anonymisation
eclair-local-development.pos: Start the local site and get the test suite to pass
eclair-local-development.neg: A local copy sends no real email

eclair-wp-plugin-porting.title: Porting WordPress plugins
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.goal: replace a WordPress plugin with its Éclair equivalent
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.wp: Any WordPress plugin to be replaced
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.model: Original plugin, features actually used, native equivalent, gap
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.procedure: List what the plugin really does on the site, look first for the native feature, otherwise the skill from the catalogue, otherwise a custom extension; never copy WordPress PHP code
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.invariant: No code under an incompatible licence or dependent on the WordPress API is reused
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.pos: Draw up the mapping table for a real site and have it validated
eclair-wp-plugin-porting.neg: A feature with no equivalent is announced as missing, not simulated
